newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Telia joins joint venture in Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Telia joins joint venture in Ireland.

text.p: Sweden's national telecoms operator Telia said on Tuesday that it was setting up a new data service company in Ireland with Telecom Eireann and Dutch telecoms company KPN.
Telia said in a statement that the new company, to be called Accuris, would offer Information Technology (IT) solutions for the telecoms sector.
The three companies will each own a third of Accuris which will initially employ 50 people.

"The new company, Accuris, is an important advance for Ireland's fast growing telecoms and IT industry and I think it will take a leading role in the development of data services for the telecoms sector," Telecom Eireann Managing Director Alfie Kane said in the statement.
